title: Two samples at the same temperature
statement:
Two beakers contain water at the same temperature, one with twice the mass of the other. Which statement is correct?

[_]{a}

choices: The larger sample requires twice as much heat for the same temperature rise.
The larger sample has twice the specific heat.
The larger sample must be hotter.
Both require the same heat for the same rise.
explanations: Its total heat capacity is doubled.
Specific heat is measured per unit mass.
The required heat depends on mass.

hints: Distinguish specific heat from heat capacity.
solution: They have the same temperature and specific heat under the same conditions. Heating the larger sample through the same temperature interval requires twice as much heat.
